name: Can I get an estimate without an on-site visit?

mainEntity.name: Can I get an estimate without an on-site visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: While we can sometimes provide a preliminary ballpark figure based on photos and detailed descriptions, a precise and accurate repair estimate almost always requires an on-site visit. This allows our team to properly assess the full extent of the damage, identify any hidden issues, take accurate measurements, and evaluate site-specific conditions. An on-site visit ensures the most reliable estimate for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A preliminary estimate might be possible with photos, but an accurate repair estimate typically requires an on-site visit to properly assess damage and site conditions.
